_meta.title: M8 Intent Gate — routing fixture (Muhammad's REAL phrasings)
_meta.source: Mined 2026-07-03 from BOLT Supabase (ltqpoupferwituusxwal): m8_conversations role='user' + m8_router_misses (logRoute/logMiss telemetry, 2026-06-25..07-02).
_meta.privacy: Sanitized for the repo: no real amounts (redacted upstream to [MONEY]/[#]), no phone numbers, first-names only. 'Sara' is kept (his wife, the household-wallet owner — load-bearing routing) per memory.
_meta.build: Intent Gate step 0. Written to FAIL against the pre-build registry; PASSES once resolveIntent() (step 1) + later layers land.

contract.note: For each case, resolveIntent(msg) -> { domain, band }. band in {strong,medium,weak,none}. acceptable defaults to [domain].
pass_if: r.domain is in acceptable  (routed to / clarifying within the right lane), OR
case.ask_ok AND r.band in {medium,weak,none}  (the gate clarifies or falls to the grounded LLM instead of a confident mis-route)
contract.hard_fail_if: case.must_not is set AND r.domain is in must_not AND r.band == 'strong'  (a confident mis-route into a forbidden lane — the exact bug class this build kills)

tiers.registry: solvable by the pure always-on registry + banding (asserted strictly in the PS 5.1 mirror)
tiers.semantic: no keyword/structure signal — needs the step-5 semantic leg or step-4 LLM-extract; ask_ok, PS mirror asserts must_not only
tiers.context: depends on conversation context — the case carries an `opts` object (e.g. {fleetRef:true} = 'asked right after a fleet answer', the exact live theft condition). resolveIntent(msg, opts) is pure over (msg,opts), so this IS asserted strictly in the PS mirror too.

contract.opts_note: opts mirrors the hints the orchestrator feeds resolveIntent: fleetRef/walletRef (last turn was a fleet/wallet reply), fleetSignal (looksFleet), memberHit (a household name). Absent = no context.
